text_en: You shall make an altar on which to offer incense; you shall make it of acacia wood.
text_cn: 你应做焚香的坛，用皂荚木制造，

text_en: It shall be one cubit long, and one cubit wide; it shall be square, and shall be two cubits high; its horns shall be of one piece with it.
text_cn: 长一肘，宽一肘，方形，高二肘，四角从坛上突出。

text_en: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, and its sides all around and its horns; and you shall make for it a molding of gold all around.
text_cn: 坛、坛的上面、四壁、周围和四角，都包上纯金；坛周围做上金花边。

text_en: And you shall make two golden rings for it; under its molding on two opposite sides of it you shall make them, and they shall hold the poles with which to carry it.
text_cn: 坛两侧花边下，做两个金环，两面都做，为穿杠杆，抬香坛之用。

text_en: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
text_cn: 用皂荚木做两根杠杆包上金。

text_en: You shall place it in front of the curtain that is above the ark of the covenant, in front of the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.
text_cn: 把香坛安置在约柜前面挂的帐幔前，就是在我与你会晤的约柜上的赎罪盖之前。

text_en: Aaron shall offer fragrant incense on it; every morning when he dresses the lamps he shall offer it,
text_cn: 亚郎要在坛上焚烧香料；每天早晨整理灯盏时要焚香；

text_en: and when Aaron sets up the lamps in the evening, he shall offer it, a regular incense offering before the Lord throughout your generations.
text_cn: 晚间亚郎换放灯盏时也要焚香：这是你们世世代代在上主前不断的焚香礼。

text_en: You shall not offer unholy incense on it, or a burnt offering, or a grain offering; and you shall not pour a drink offering on it.
text_cn: 在这坛上不准焚别的香，也不准献全燔祭和素祭或奠祭。

text_en: Once a year Aaron shall perform the rite of atonement on its horns. Throughout your generations he shall perform the atonement for it once a year with the blood of the atoning sin offering. It is most holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 亚郎每年一次在这坛的四角上行赎罪礼，用赎罪祭赎罪牺牲的血，每年一次为这坛行赎罪礼。你们世世代代应行此礼，将坛祝圣于上主为至圣之物。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: When you take a census of the Israelites to register them, at registration all of them shall give a ransom for their lives to the Lord , so that no plague may come upon them for being registered.
text_cn: “当你统计以色列子民人数的时候，凡被统计的人，每人应献给上主赎命金，免得在统计的时候，灾祸降在他们身上。

text_en: This is what each one who is registered shall give: half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs), half a shekel as an offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 凡被统计过的，每人应按圣所的衡量缴纳半‘协刻耳’，——‘协刻耳’等于二十‘革辣’，──这半‘协刻耳’是给上主的献仪。

text_en: Each one who is registered, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the Lord ’s offering.
text_cn: 凡被统计过的，自二十岁以上起，要献给上主献仪：

text_en: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when you bring this offering to the Lord to make atonement for your lives.
text_cn: 富的不多纳，穷的也不少出，一概出半‘协刻耳’，给上主作献仪，作你们的赎命金。

text_en: You shall take the atonement money from the Israelites and shall designate it for the service of the tent of meeting; before the Lord it will be a reminder to the Israelites of the ransom given for your lives.
text_cn: 你从以色列子民所取的赎命金，应拿来为会幕用。这为子民在上主前是一个记念，也赎回了你们的性命。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: You shall make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. You shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it;
text_cn: “你应做一铜盆和铜盆座，为洗濯（zhuó）之用；把盆安在会幕和祭坛之间，盆中放上水，

text_en: with the water Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet.
text_cn: 好叫亚郎和他的儿子们在盆中洗手洗脚。

text_en: When they go into the tent of meeting, or when they come near the altar to minister, to make an offering by fire to the Lord , they shall wash with water, so that they may not die.
text_cn: 他们进会幕，或走近祭坛行礼，或向上主焚烧火祭时，要用水洗，免得死亡。

text_en: They shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they may not die: it shall be a perpetual ordinance for them, for him and for his descendants throughout their generations.
text_cn: 他们应洗手洗脚，免得死亡：这为他和他的子孙世世代代是永远的规律。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Take the finest spices: of liquid myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet-smelling cinnamon half as much, that is, two hundred fifty, and two hundred fifty of aromatic cane,
text_cn: “你要拿上等的香料：纯正没药五百‘协刻耳’，香肉桂为没药的一半，即二百五十‘协刻耳’，香菖蒲二百五十‘协刻耳’，

text_en: and five hundred of cassia—measured by the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil;
text_cn: 桂皮按圣所的衡量五百‘协刻耳’，橄榄油一‘辛’，

text_en: and you shall make of these a sacred anointing oil blended as by the perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
text_cn: 用这些材料配制傅礼用的圣油，像配制香膏的方法配制，作为傅礼用的圣油。

text_en: With it you shall anoint the tent of meeting and the ark of the covenant,
text_cn: 用此油傅会幕和约柜，

text_en: and the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,
text_cn: 供桌和其上的一切器具，灯台和一切用具，香坛，

text_en: and the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand;
text_cn: 全燔祭坛和坛上的一切用具、盆和盆座。

text_en: you shall consecrate them, so that they may be most holy; whatever touches them will become holy.
text_cn: 你祝圣过的，都成了至圣之物，凡接触这些物件的，也成为圣的。

text_en: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, in order that they may serve me as priests.
text_cn: 你也要给亚郎和他的儿子们傅油，祝圣他们作我的司祭。

text_en: You shall say to the Israelites, “This shall be my holy anointing oil throughout your generations.
text_cn: 你要吩咐以色列子民说：你们应世世代代以此为傅礼用的圣油，

text_en: It shall not be used in any ordinary anointing of the body, and you shall make no other like it in composition; it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.
text_cn: 不准将此油倒在俗人身上，也不准用这配制的方法配制这样的油，因为是圣油，你们应以为圣物。

text_en: Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it on an unqualified person shall be cut off from the people. ”
text_cn: 无论谁若配制这样的油，或用这油傅了凡人，应将他从百姓中铲除。”

text_en: The Lord said to Moses: Take sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, sweet spices with pure frankincense (an equal part of each),
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“你要取这些香料：就是苏合香、香螺和白松香；这些香料与纯乳香应有相等的分量，

text_en: and make an incense blended as by the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy;
text_cn: 以香膏的配制法配成香，再加上盐，使之成为纯洁和圣的。

text_en: and you shall beat some of it into powder, and put part of it before the covenant in the tent of meeting where I shall meet with you; it shall be for you most holy.
text_cn: 将一部分研成碎末，献在会幕中的约柜前，即我与你会晤的地方；这为你们是至圣之物。

text_en: When you make incense according to this composition, you shall not make it for yourselves; it shall be regarded by you as holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 你所配制的这种香，不准配制为自己用，应当作圣物，只为上主用。

text_en: Whoever makes any like it to use as perfume shall be cut off from the people.
text_cn: 无论谁若配制这样的香料，为闻香气，应将他从百姓中铲除。”
